signature.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
signature.detail: Cleveland's defining attraction, a striking glass pyramid on the lakefront packed with music memorabilia and interactive exhibits. Book tickets online in advance to skip lines, and go on a weekday morning for the calmest visit.

signature.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
signature.detail: A world-class encyclopedic collection in University Circle, famous for its Asian art and free general admission. Visit on a weekday afternoon to avoid crowds; it's easily reached by bus or rideshare.

signature.name: West Side Market
signature.detail: A historic public market in Ohio City with dozens of vendors selling produce, meats, baked goods and prepared food. Come hungry on a weekday morning when it's less packed, and bring cash for smaller stalls.

signature.name: Playhouse Square
signature.detail: One of the largest performing arts centers in the country, with restored 1920s theaters hosting Broadway shows and concerts. Check the schedule ahead and arrive early to admire the chandelier in the lobby.

signature.name: Cleveland Metroparks Zoo
signature.detail: A large, well-regarded zoo with an indoor rainforest and Australian adventure area, good for families. Go early in the day for active animals and buy tickets online for a discount.

signature.name: Great Lakes Science Center
signature.detail: A hands-on science museum next to the Rock Hall with a domed theater, ideal for kids and rainy days. Combine it with the lakefront attractions nearby and check showtimes on arrival.

signature.name: Severance Hall
signature.detail: The elegant home of the Cleveland Orchestra, renowned for its acoustics and architecture. Catch a concert if you can, or join a guided tour; dress is smart-casual for most performances.

transport: RTA rail $2.50 a ride; rideshares moderate
